primary_result: The TICO-to-Books fairness-gain shift is real in the frozen sample but its decomposition is partition-dependent: baseline gap-sign groups emphasize composition whereas baseline length groups emphasize within-group residual. This prevents a unique mechanism attribution.
support_result: The 3-by-4 sign-by-length table is not estimable under the frozen support rule: zero-gap/q4 has 0 TICO rows versus 25 Books rows, and the minimum nonzero TICO cell contains one row. The coarse 2-by-2 table has no empty cell but a minimum TICO count of four and is not used for causal or method-selection claims.
claim_scope: Deterministic, correlated, exposed English-French diagnostics only; not causality, independent confirmation, broader multilingual evidence or original-paper reproduction.
next_action: Do not refine or select a method on the exposed Books/TICO outcomes. Restore a substantially larger genuinely unexposed author/domain set and provenance-complete third-language training data; then prospectively freeze minimum cell support and test a sign-robust/no-harm candidate on separate development and confirmation data.
